Not everything works but, with this unbreakable musical, it doesn't need to
Hadley Fraser and Kexiah Ibe in an impressive stage debut star in a spirited revival of Lerner and Loewe’s musical classic, directed by Rachel Kavanaugh
This is a simply exceptional production of the musical theatre classic My Fair Lady, featuring stunning costumes, hilarious performances, thrilling choreography and cock-e-nay accents galore.

This is three hours of pure theatrical pleasure with a wonderful cast, rich and perfect sound mix, clever staging and fresh inventive choreography that shows off the brilliant score and transformational narrative to perfection.

This revival of the 1956 musical was an absolute delight which had the audience clapping along, laughing and giving the cast deserved acknowledgment with a theatre wide standing ovation at the performance’s conclusion.

I praise without hesitation the calibre of both performances and musicality of, and, in the show, and I'm positive it will be a great success, but, in all honesty, I left disappointed in the visual reimagination of some of the most beloved set pieces in musical theatre.

This My Fair Lady is fresh, funny, exciting; full of unexpected treats and insightful characterisations, spectacular choreography, glorious harmonies, and song after song that will keep you singing this outstanding score for days to come.
